title: Navigation — Replacement of the Magnetron Weather Radar Transceiver by a Solid State Unit

ata.title: Independent Position Determining — Weather Radar Transceiver

abstract: Retrofit of the solid state weather radar transceiver on aircraft delivered with the magnetron unit, removing the transmitter life limit and roughly doubling the scan rate.

sections.planning_reason: The magnetron transceiver carries a hard life limit on the transmitter tube and is removed at about six thousand five hundred flight hours regardless of condition, which costs the fleet roughly one hundred and forty scheduled removals a year. The supplier has given notice that the tube will go out of production, so operators who do not embody will face an increasing spares difficulty. Crews have also asked for a faster picture refresh in convective weather and the scan rate of the delivered unit is the limiting factor.
sections.description: The bulletin removes the magnetron transceiver and its packer plates and installs the solid state unit on the existing radome bulkhead tray with new mounting hardware, then re-loads the interface unit for the higher data rate.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Open the radome and support it clear of the bulkhead. Do the removal task AMM-C-34-40-11-000-013-A for the magnetron transceiver. Remove the packer plates from the tray and keep them with the aircraft records. Install the solid state transceiver D3440119270001 on the tray using washers AES311855K5 and AGS393059-2A and torque to the value in the task. Re-shim the rack at functional item 2FE and record the shim stack. Re-load the interface unit D3440005921121 from the maintenance terminal. Do a bonding check at the tray. Do the radar functional test and the display bus check with the control panel D3440004285173. Close the radome and record the embodiment.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to CIRRANE-11 and CIRRANE-13 aircraft from MSN C00001 to MSN C00273 delivered with the magnetron transceiver. Aircraft from MSN C00273 onward already carry the solid state unit. Aircraft brought to the stabilised antenna drive standard are outside this bulletin, which is superseded for them by the later change.
sections.material_note: Kit K3440-2003-01 contains the transceiver and the mounting hardware. Lead time was originally fifty-two weeks and is now twenty-six. The removed magnetron transceiver is returned to the supplier and attracts a credit under the exchange agreement.

type_data.compliance_time: At the next transmitter life limit removal, or at the operator's convenience.
